card.name: Word just before "per" in rates
card.fires_on: The last word or word piece of a quantity right before the word "per" (or Spanish "por"), as in "beats per minute" or "parts per billion". It predicts that "per" comes next.

modes.label: Unit before per
modes.description: A unit or count noun that completes a rate, followed by "per".
modes.example: Count your pulse for 10 seconds and multiply by 6 to find your<< beats>> per minute.

modes.label: Amount before per dose
modes.description: Ending of a drug name or number in a label statement of content per amount.
modes.example: CONTAINS 14.0 mg PHENYLALAN<<INE>> PER 5 GRAM DOSE.

modes.label: Cost or count in a rate
modes.description: A cost or number word where "per" is expected next.
modes.example: At an average start-up resettlement cost of at least US$12,00<<0>> per family

card.writes: It promotes "por", "par" and "per"-like tokens, so it adds the word "per" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "per" in rates like beats per minute or parts per billion.
